verdict.rationale: n8n supports self-hosting and a documented 'source control and environments' feature (push/pull changes) that implies separate dev/staging/production environments, and self-hosting itself lets a user spin up an isolated instance without touching production data. However there's no explicit sandbox/test-mode feature marketed for AI-native testing, no dedicated test-data isolation tooling, and no community evidence confirming this workflow in practice. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment feature, documentation on isolating test runs from production data, and independent confirmation of this use case working as described.
